primary_heading.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Apply tracking-tight for a sleek, futuristic look.

body.usage: Standard body text, forms, and general UI elements.

monospace.usage: Use exclusively for times, hours, labor cost numbers, and compliance metrics to ensure tabular alignment.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Apply 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 shadow-2xl' for top-level cards, sidebars, and navs. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it (e.g., Dropdown).
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop shadows on neon accents: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)]' for active states or the 1-click Generate button.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px inner borders 'border-white/10' on all glass elements to define edges against the dark background.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_overview: Use 'High Density Grid' (Bento grid style). Base grid: 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4' with 'gap-6'.
grids_and_layouts.roster_timeline: Horizontal scrolling overflow container. Solid background cells (not glass) for the Mon-Sun grid to ensure high data legibility. Fixed left column for employee names/avatars.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use 'p-6' or 'p-8' inside dashboard widget cards. Use 'gap-4' for list items.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped ('rounded-full'). Primary buttons must use the neon accent gradient with hover scale 'hover:scale-105 transition-transform'. Secondary buttons: glass effect with white text.
component_rules.inputs_and_forms: Solid dark backgrounds ('bg-[#0A0B10]') with 'border-white/10'. DO NOT use glassmorphism for inputs to prevent text refraction and readability loss.
component_rules.roster_chips: Small, rounded ('rounded-md'), utilizing the 'role_chips' color scheme. Must include clear typography.
component_rules.modals: Use Shadcn dialogs customized with dark glassmorphism backgrounds ('bg-[#05050A]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/10').
component_rules.dropdowns: Must have a solid or highly opaque blurred background ('bg-[#0A0B10]/95 backdrop-blur-xl'). NEVER fully transparent.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on roster chips (slight lift '-translate-y-0.5' and increased border opacity).
motion.toasts: Use 'sonner' for email dispatch simulation and conflict resolution feedback. Style toasts with dark glass.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Use text shadow if placing text over any varied background.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' for confetti and hover lifts.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

image_urls.usage_instructions: Use avatars for employee management list, roster row headers, and email dispatch modal. Use background_ambience with a heavy black overlay (e.g., 'bg-black/80') for the login/signup screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hybrid fullstack SaaS dashboard. Use standard React .js syntax, NOT .tsx. Provide the implementation in .js files.
Implement the UI using a dark glassmorphism aesthetic. Do not make the entire app transparent; anchor it with a dark #05050A base.
For the Weekly Roster Timeline: Construct a dense, horizontally scrollable data grid. Use solid backgrounds for cells, and colored pills/chips for shifts.
Implement a 1-click 'Generate Roster' button that uses a neon gradient and shows a simulated progress state before revealing the roster.
Ensure the Conflict Badge is distinct and catches attention immediately (e.g., pulsating dot or high-contrast red badge).
Install and use 'canvas-confetti' for the successful dispatch micro-interaction.
Install 'sonner' for toast notifications and trigger it on 'Publish' or 'Email Dispatch'.
All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute for testing. Example: 'data-testid="login-button"'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not use Inter for headings.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with subtle 1px white/10 borders.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all'). Add transitions specifically for interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container. Preserve human reading flow (left-aligned).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations (hover scale, brightness).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis like bot, brain, or stars as icons. Use Lucide React icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
